severance.name: Severance Plan
severance.summary: Lump-sum payment for Legends with at least 2 Credited Seasons. Automatically issued ~12 months after last contract.
severance.amount_or_value: $30,000–$50,000 per year for 2020–2030 (depends on seasons earned)
how_to_access: Payment is automatic if eligible.
Verify/update permanent home address with the Plan so the check reaches you.
Call NFL Customer Service Center or visit NFLPlayerBenefits.com.
cautions: Address must be current; otherwise payment may be delayed or lost.

capital_accumulation.name: Capital Accumulation Plan
capital_accumulation.summary: Club-funded retirement investment account. You direct the investments.
how_to_access: Access as early as age 40 or 5 years after last Credited Season (whichever later).
Log into NFLPlayerBenefits.com or call to manage investments/withdrawals.
cautions: Withdrawals before age 59½ may incur 10% IRS early withdrawal penalty.
eligibility_rule_descriptions: Account exists from Club contributions during playing years

annuity.name: Annuity Program
annuity.summary: Club-funded retirement benefit with Tax-Qualified and/or Nonqualified accounts.
how_to_access: Portion may be available as early as 5 years after last Credited Season.
Contact the plan administrator via NFLPlayerBenefits.com.
cautions: Tax-Qualified withdrawals before 59½ may have 10% penalty.
eligibility_rule_descriptions: Club contributions were made during active years

401k.name: 401(k) Savings Plan
401k.summary: Salary deferrals + Club contributions during playing years. You direct investments.
how_to_access: Access as early as age 45.
Manage via NFLPlayerBenefits.com or phone.
cautions: Early withdrawals before 59½ may incur 10% penalty.

pension.name: Pension Plan
pension.summary: Monthly retirement benefit based on total Credited Seasons and years earned. Payable as early as age 55 (defer to 65 for higher amount).
pension.amount_or_value: Increased to $600 per Credited Season for seasons prior to 2012 (eff. Apr 1, 2025); post-2011 seasons +10% under 2020 CBA. Pre-1993 players with 3+ seasons now eligible.
how_to_access: Apply via NFLPlayerBenefits.com or call.
Elect start date (55–65).
Must apply before electing certain other benefits in some cases.
cautions: Application timing matters relative to other disability benefits.
eligibility_rule_descriptions: Typically vested with sufficient Credited Seasons (often 3+); Pre-1993 with 3+ now covered

tuition.name: NFL Player Tuition Assistance Plan
tuition.summary: Reimbursement for tuition, fees, and books (100% up to lifetime max). Also covers approved trade/business management programs.
how_to_access: 1. Verify eligibility and qualifying institution before enrolling (call or email).
2. Submit reimbursement request + docs within 6 months of class completion (or grade post / 30 days after finals).
3. Receive check if rules met.
tuition.deadlines: Expenses within ~6 years of last game; claim within 6 months of completion.
eligibility_rule_descriptions: Expenses incurred within 72 months of the first day of the Plan Year following last regular/postseason game

cv_coverage.name: NFL Player Insurance Plan — Continuing Veteran (CV)
cv_coverage.summary: 5 years of free extended medical, behavioral health, dental, vision, and Rx coverage after final active season for you and eligible dependents.
how_to_access: Coverage is automatic for eligible players.
Manage via myCigna.com or call.
eligibility_rule_descriptions: Completed final season as Active Player

dedicated_hospital.name: NFL Dedicated Hospital Network Program
dedicated_hospital.summary: After CV coverage ends: limited benefit access to high-quality network for preventive, primary, and mental health services (Annual Maximums apply). Available until age 65.
how_to_access: Must contact Dedicated Concierge Team PRIOR to each visit.
Dependents not eligible.
cautions: Contact concierge first; Annual Maximums renew Sept 1.

disability_lod.name: Line of Duty Disability
disability_lod.summary: For partial disability due to NFL-football activities.
how_to_access: Apply via NFL Disability Benefits process.
Call for guidance.
disability_lod.deadlines: Strict application windows based on Credited Seasons.
eligibility_rule_descriptions: If ≤4 Credited Seasons: apply within 4 years of last Active Player date. If 5+: deadline = number of Credited Seasons.

disability_neuro.name: Neurocognitive Disability
disability_neuro.summary: For mild to moderate brain impairment.
how_to_access: Apply through Disability Plan process.
eligibility_rule_descriptions: Must be Vested Inactive under Pension Plan, OR if not vested apply within 7 years of last Active date.

disability_tp.name: Total and Permanent Disability
disability_tp.summary: Unable to work due to disability.
how_to_access: Apply prior to Pension election.
cautions: Timing relative to Pension election is critical.
eligibility_rule_descriptions: Must be Vested Inactive Player; application before electing Pension. Non-vested limited cases possible.

hra.name: Health Reimbursement Account (HRA) Plan
hra.summary: Club-funded account to help pay health expenses after CV coverage ends. Covers you, spouse, eligible dependents.
how_to_access: Use for qualified health expenses.
Manage via plan portal.
eligibility_rule_descriptions: Eligible Vested Legend with HRA balance from Club contributions

fplip.name: Former Player Life-Improvement Plan (FPLIP)
fplip.summary: Bundle including discount Rx card, Vested Inactive Life Insurance ($40k + $2k/extra season up to $50k), Joint Replacement reimbursement (up to $5,250), Assisted Living access, Enhanced Assessment/Counseling (2 visits/year), Medicare subsidy (up to $200/mo at 65+).
how_to_access: Discount Rx: available at participating pharmacies.
Life Insurance: designate beneficiary via form on NFLPlayerBenefits.com.
Joint Replacement: submit for reimbursement (one per joint).
Medicare: through Alight Retiree Health Solutions at 65+.
cautions: Life insurance ends at age 55 or pension start.

pfrpa_dental.name: PFRPA Dental Plan
pfrpa_dental.summary: Delta Dental coverage for Legends who retired by July 2013 (and spouse option). Not collectively bargained.
pfrpa_dental.amount_or_value: Preventive 100%, Basic 70%, Major 50%; $25 deductible; $3,000 calendar max
how_to_access: Contact PFRPA / Delta Dental.

pfrpa_vision.name: PFRPA Vision Plan
pfrpa_vision.summary: VSP Vision Care for Legends who effectively retired by July 2013 (spouse option). Not collectively bargained.
how_to_access: Contact PFRPA / VSP.

total_wellness.name: NFL Total Wellness
total_wellness.summary: Holistic support: mental health literacy trainings, Headspace app (shareable with 5 family), monthly webinars, Wellness Retreat, Coordination of Care, Transition Coaches, NFL Life Line.
how_to_access: Email TotalWellness@nfl.com for training registration, Headspace, retreats, coaches.
NFL Life Line: 800.506.0078 or nflifeline.org (24/7 urgent support).
eligibility_rule_descriptions: Available to NFL Legends and family

transition_coaches.name: NFL Transition Coaches
transition_coaches.summary: Peer Legends with 70+ hours training providing one-on-one support for wellness, resource access, care coordination, and crisis management.
how_to_access: Email totalwellness@nfl.com or complete Transition Coach Referral form.

player_engagement.name: NFL Player Engagement
player_engagement.summary: Programs under four pillars: Continuing Education, Financial Empowerment, Professional Development, Personal Development.
how_to_access: Visit players.nfl.com or contact Player Engagement.

legends_networks.name: Legends Business / Coaches / Media Networks
legends_networks.summary: Exclusive networks for business owners/aspirants, coaches, and media professionals with education, mentorship, resources, and NFL partner opportunities.
how_to_access: Register via Players Community portal at players.nfl.com.

legends_grant.name: Legends Community Grant
legends_grant.summary: $5,000 quarterly grant from funds raised on NFL Auction Legends page. For community give-back.
how_to_access: Visit players.nfl.com or email NFLLegends@NFL.com.

portal.name: Players Community Portal & App + NFL Player Benefits App
portal.summary: Central digital hubs for resources, benefits, events, RSVPs, trusted users, perks, and account management.
how_to_access: players.nfl.com — create account or sign in.
Download Players Community App and NFL Player Benefits App (App Store / Google Play).
